**Lamina 0.4.1 is out!** 🎉

This one is for the moment you stand at the machine. And it fixes what new users met first in 0.4.0.

**Parts stay in the sheet.** Set *holding bridges* on *Sheet & fit*: each part keeps a few short uncut stretches, and snaps out by hand after the cut.

**Find your kerf first.** Export step 1 has a *kerf test*: seven squares and their holes. Cut it from a scrap, and the square that fits its hole snug names your kerf.

**Cut length, time and cost.** The Export tab shows how much there is to cut, score and engrave, and a machine time and price from your own speeds.

**A printable assembly guide.** *Assembly guide* on the Export tab opens a card for each build step, with a 3D picture of the new part and its outline.

**Cut the 3D view open.** The *section* control, next to *explode*, cuts the view across x, y or z. The cut files stay the same.

**Guides with a picture per step.** The six guides on the site show the app at every step, and their links open the guide's own technique.

Fixed too: the blob and six more examples open clean on cardboard, folded print examples open clean on the site, printed panels stay on their plate, and shared project files open safely.

Everything new, with a picture for each: *help* → *What is new*.
The guides: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/?ref=discord-0.4.1#guides>

Try it: <https://marcelfarres.github.io/lamina/app/?ref=discord-0.4.1>

Which one will you try first?
